description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ClaimDaoTest' for testing the ClaimDao data access object related to claim events and claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases for CRUD operations, and interactions with various entity classes.

classes.name: ClaimDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests various methods of the ClaimDao class for managing claim events and claim requests in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimDao instance and populates test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests saving a new ClaimEvent and verifies its name and status.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of claim events based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a claim event by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests deleting claim events by their IDs.

methods.name: testCountClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests counting claim events with specific filters.

methods.name: testSaveExpenseType
methods.description: Tests saving a new ExpenseType and verifies its name and associated user.

methods.name: testSaveClaimRequest
methods.description: Tests saving a claim request related to a claim event with specific details.

methods.name: testGetNextId
methods.description: Tests retrieving the next available ID for claim-related entities.

methods.name: testIsClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Tests checking whether a claim event is used.
